description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Test Developer based in the United States . 

 As a Test Developer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality assessments for professional credentialing and certification organizations. You will collaborate with psychometricians, subject matter experts (SMEs), and client representatives to ensure assessments are accurate, reliable, and fair. This role combines assessment development, project coordination, quality assurance, and client relationship management. You will oversee the development process from initial item creation through examination assembly and delivery. Working in a fully remote environment, you will manage multiple projects while ensuring deadlines, quality standards, and client expectations are consistently met. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to meaningful assessment programs while developing your expertise in testing and credentialing. 



Accountabilities:
 

 
 
 
 Assessment and Item Development: Coordinate item-writing and review activities with subject matter experts, provide guidance on assessment development best practices, facilitate review meetings, and edit examination items to ensure clarity, fairness, consistency, and compliance with established guidelines. 







 
 
 
 Item Banking and Examination Development: Import and manage assessment items within item banking platforms, maintain accurate content and metadata, monitor item inventories, conduct gap analyses, and assemble examination forms according to documented specifications and psychometric recommendations. 







 
 
 
 Quality Assurance: Perform comprehensive quality checks on examination items, answer keys, and assessment forms to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with technical and content requirements. 







 
 
 
 Project and Delivery Management: Coordinate activities across multiple client projects, manage priorities and deadlines, track development milestones and deliverables, and communicate progress and outstanding actions to relevant stakeholders. 







 
 
 
 Client Relationship Management: Act as a primary point of contact for assigned clients, develop a strong understanding of their assessment programs, build long-term relationships, manage expectations, and support successful client retention. 







 
 
 
 Client Training and Support: Onboard new clients, educate stakeholders on assessment development best practices and software functionality, and provide guidance throughout the assessment lifecycle. 







 
 
 
 Examination Publishing and Continuous Improvement: Support examination publishing, delivery, and results processing, coordinate approval meetings with authors, and contribute to improving internal procedures, workflows, and service delivery standards. 








 Requirements: 


 
 
 
 Bachelor's degree, preferably in Psychology, Education, Human Resources, or another assessment-related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 







 
 
 
 At least 2 years of experience in assessment project or program management, preferably within the credentialing or certification industry. 







 
 
 
 Working knowledge of test development principles and practices, including job analysis, standard setting, item writing, and examination assembly. 







 
 
 
 Experience coordinating subject matter experts and managing assessment development and review processes. 







 
 
 
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, with the ability to prepare professional documentation, reports, and presentations. 







 
 
 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to facilitate meetings and communicate effectively with clients and technical stakeholders. 







 
 
 
 Strong organizational, project management, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments and competing deadlines. 







 
 
 
 Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote team. 







 
 
 
 Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous professional development. 








 Preferred qualifications: 


 
 
 
 Previous experience working for a credentialing, certification, or educational assessment organization. 







 
 
 
 Familiarity with item banking software and online examination platforms. 







 
 
 
 Understanding of project management methodologies and practices. 







 
 
 
 Knowledge of NCCA or ANSI accreditation requirements for certification programs. 







 
 
 
 Motivation to continuously expand technical knowledge and stay informed about assessment industry best practices. 








 Benefits: 


 
 
 
 Competitive annual salary: Target compensation of $60,000–$75,000 , depending on experience and qualifications. 







 
 
 
 Fully remote position: Work from anywhere within the United States. 







 
 
 
 Flexible and collaborative environment: Join a fully virtual organization with a generally casual dress culture. 







 
 
 
 Standard working schedule: Monday through Friday, typically 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. in a U.S. time zone. 







 
 
 
 Professional development: Opportunities to expand expertise in assessment development, psychometrics, and credentialing programs. 







 
 
 
 Limited travel: Approximately 5% annually, typically around one week per year. 







 
 
 
 Collaborative culture: Work alongside experienced assessment professionals, psychometricians, and industry specialists. 







 
 
 
 Meaningful impact: Contribute to the quality, reliability, and fairness of professional certification and assessment programs.
